component.name: Phomemo Printer App
component.summary: Print labels with Phomemo Bluetooth printers

description.p: An experimental session-scoped printer server with a browser-based interface. Launch the application to start printing, and use its Stop Server desktop action when finished. Closing the browser does not stop the server.
Supports direct job submission and IPP printing. Bluetooth pairing and optional CUPS queue setup are performed on the host. Distributed through GitHub releases.
